title: Balance-Size Points on Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Deficiency Settlements
content:
The settlement percentage on a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract follows the amount of the most recent deficiency quote — a payoff quote issued to the customer — on the account, the first one listed where two share a date.

| Amount of the most recent deficiency quote | Balance-size adjustment |
|---|---|
| $3000.00 or more (the large-balance amount) | lowered by 5 points (the large-balance points) |
| Below $1000.00 (the small-balance amount) | raised by 10 points (the small-balance points) |
| $1000.00 up to $2999.99 | unchanged |

### Boundaries (hypothetical quotes)

| Quote | Adjustment |
|---|---|
| $3000.00 | lowered by 5 points |
| $2999.99 | unchanged |
| $1000.00 | unchanged |
| $999.99 | raised by 10 points |
